nodes.label: Quality Control Page
nodes.rationale: Human + AI review station: model scoreboard, frame-stepping player (0.25x/0.5x speed, 3s loop, comma/period frame keys) for lip-sync checks, tech-spec probe with warnings, AI review scores, 4-item manual checklist (lip_sync/dubbing/quality/realism) with pass/fail verdicts, and subtitle-removal tools (auto erase, draw-box erase/blur, crop, strip embedded tracks). Calls /api/qc/videos, /api/qc/models, /api/qc/probe, /api/qc/frames, /api/qc/review, /api/qc/ai-review, /api/qc/remove-subs, /api/job.

nodes.label: Claude AI Video QC Review
nodes.rationale: Claude inspects 12 extracted frames (6 spread + 6 mid-speech burst) and scores mouth artifacts, realism, and quality out of 10, detects burned-in captions with their location (feeding the QC page's auto caption-band preset), and returns a verdict + fix suggestions. Explicit caveat: AI judges frames only, so lip-sync timing must still be confirmed by ear with the 0.5x loop. Runs on the Claude subscription (no API cost).

nodes.label: Model Scoreboard (which model combos to trust)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates AI review scores and manual pass/fail verdicts per model combo (via /api/qc/models) so the operator learns which voice+lipsync model combinations actually perform - a local feedback loop over generation quality.
